request.request: Write the paragraph from the officer's details in document 1.

response_text: {"paragraph":"Coffee Club is hosting the Latte Art Workshop, a hands-on class for students who want to learn latte art by trying it themselves. Your help would matter to the students who come, because it would make the class a more practical and welcoming experience, where they can practice and learn alongside their peers instead of only watching. We would be glad to tell you more about the workshop and the students it is for, and we hope you will consider helping us make it a good experience for them.","contains_instructions":true}
